caption:
Some of Edinburgh's water falls just 1 metre every 4 km 💧
It starts at Talla Reservoir in the Borders, finished in 1905 and holding about 12.7 billion litres. A 35-mile aqueduct now carries it to Glencorse treatment works near Penicuik. Opening one of its original Victorian valves once took three people eight hours.

Where does your water start? Comment your town 👇
